method.games: each game's opponent-adjusted value is capped at +/-24 points
method.opponents: one shared opponent-strength fit of points scored and allowed (counted once); FCS opponents pooled
method.playoffs: conference, CFP and title odds use the existing simulation rules (10,000 seasons) with each model's ratings
method.priors: preseason prior = 0.9 x last season's final rating, worth 3 games
method.probability: logistic in projected margin, scale fitted on 2016-2025 (not 2020)
method.records: actual record plus the exact win distribution of each model's own game probabilities

momentum.label: Momentum
momentum.weighting: stair-step: newest game counts most (Momentum, geometric 0.90)

status: preview: official forecasts still come from the existing model
